mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an international organization dealing with the global rules of trade between nations."
WTO is an international organization dealing with the global rules of trade between nations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an adhoc organization under the United Nations."
The ECO is an adhoc organization under the United Nations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the outcome of the first major effort to adopt rules to govern international trade relations which was made by countries in the years immediately after the second world war."
The WTO concept is the outcome of the first major effort to adopt rules to govern international trade relations which was made by countries in the years immediately after the second world war.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as an act by which the governments placing of duties or quotas on imports to protect domestic industries from global competition."
Protectionism can be defined as an act by which the governments placing of duties or quotas on imports to protect domestic industries from global competition.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an economic loss which a country suffers on account of an increase in its factor endowment or a natural windfall (like the discovery of huge oil resources or deposit of a mineral)."

The Dutch disease is an economic loss which a country suffers on account of an increase in its factor endowment or a natural windfall (like the discovery of huge oil resources or deposit of a mineral).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the possibility that an unexpected change in exchange rates will cause a change in the future cash flows of a firm and its market value."
Operating or economic exposure is the possibility that an unexpected change in exchange rates will cause a change in the future cash flows of a firm and its market value.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the exchange of capital, goods and services across international borders or territories."
International trade is the exchange of capital, goods and services across international borders or territories.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as the most a ambitious and complex of the eight rounds of negotiations under GATT."
The Uruguay Round is regarded as the most a ambitious and complex of the eight rounds of negotiations under GATT.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financial intermediary, harmonizing the needs of deficit units, and those of surplus units."
A bank is a financial intermediary, harmonizing the needs of deficit units, and those of surplus units.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fundamentally important activity running throughout the work of the WTO."
Surveillance of national trade policies is a fundamentally important activity running throughout the work of the WTO.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for global agreements, negotiations and ensures regulations and rule made by all is obeyed by all."
The organization is responsible for global agreements, negotiations and ensures regulations and rule made by all is obeyed by all.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indirect taxes imposed upon imports."
A tariff is an indirect taxes imposed upon imports.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the upon whom the letter of credits is drawn, the bank is authorized by the letter of credit to pay the sum involved after the stated conditions are met."
The paying bank is the upon whom the letter of credits is drawn, the bank is authorized by the letter of credit to pay the sum involved after the stated conditions are met.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the practice of promoting trade between two countries through agreements concerning quantity and price of commodities."
Bilateralism is the practice of promoting trade between two countries through agreements concerning quantity and price of commodities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a debit while an export is a credit."
An import is a debit while an export is a credit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the direct exchange of goods between two parties in a transaction."
Barter is the direct exchange of goods between two parties in a transaction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the bank mandated to verify and accept the documents indicated in the letter of credit."
The accepting bank is the bank mandated to verify and accept the documents indicated in the letter of credit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means exchange goods or services which are paid for, in whole or part, with other goods or services, rather than with money."
Counter trade means exchange goods or services which are paid for, in whole or part, with other goods or services, rather than with money.
fib: ______ is a concept of international law that declares if a state provides certain right and privileges to its own citizens, it also should provide equivalent rights and privileges to foreigners.
National Treatment

National Treatment is a concept of international law that declares if a state provides certain right and privileges to its own citizens, it also should provide equivalent rights and privileges to foreigners.
______ is a nation's ability to produce a particular product with fewer resources (per unit of output) than any other nation.
absolute advantage
An absolute advantage is a nation's ability to produce a particular product with fewer resources (per unit of output) than any other nation.
______ is a sale that encompasses more than an exchange of goods, service or ideas for money.
Counter-trade
Counter-trade is a sale that encompasses more than an exchange of goods, service or ideas for money.

______ are concerned about the trend toward counter trade, yet in light of existing competition and the need to find creative ways of financing trade, they exercise very little interference with counter trade.
Government and international organization

Government and international organization are concerned about the trend toward counter trade, yet in light of existing competition and the need to find creative ways of financing trade, they exercise very little interference with counter trade.
______ is the author of a letter of credit.
issuing bank
The issuing bank is the author of a letter of credit.

free exchange-rate markets
The free exchange-rate markets is a monetary arrangement whereby the exchange rate is freely and competitively determined by the forces of demand and supply of foreign exchange.

trade agreement
A trade agreement is a contract/agreement/fact between two or more nations that outlines how they will work together to ensure mutual benefit in the field of trade and investment.

board of governors

SDRs
The SDRs are the paper money created by the international monetary Funds (IMF).

Annexed are the agreements on goods, services and intellectual properly, dispute settlement, trade policy review mechanism and the plurilateral agreements.
______ are referred to as floating rates or flexible rates.
Rates so freely determined
Rates so freely determined are referred to as floating rates or flexible rates.
______ is the oldest UN organization and operates with labour business and government representatives setting and enforcing minimum labour standards, including standards for migrant workers.
international labour organization

The international labour organization is the oldest UN organization and operates with labour business and government representatives setting and enforcing minimum labour standards, including standards for migrant workers.

Economic cooperation organization

Economic cooperation organization is an intergovernmental regional organization established in 1985 by Iran, Pakistan and Turkey for the purpose of promoting economic, technical and cultural cooperation among the member states.
______ are those transactions whose terms are denominated in a currency other than the entities functional currency.
Foreign currency transacted
Foreign currency transacted are those transactions whose terms are denominated in a currency other than the entities functional currency.
______ are the Merchandise Trade Accounts, the Invisible (Services) Accounts, the Capital Accounts and the Balance of payments.
major accounts kept
The major accounts kept are the Merchandise Trade Accounts, the Invisible (Services) Accounts, the Capital Accounts and the Balance of payments.

______ are a way of life for business managers today.
International trade and production

Terms of trade
